g.text: E2 / F5: no phonemes, no durations — three equal-length tracks into one Transformer; alignment happens in attention
all three have length T, concatenated per frame → Transformer (F5: ConvNeXt on the text first); MSE on the masked frames only
training = infilling (Voicebox): mask a stretch of a real mel, generate it from the rest and all the text
use: the same picture with the prompt's mel kept and the part to generate zeroed — but its length T must come from outside:
